lines.text: Each man should have his own wife and each woman her own husband, stopping only by mutual consent for prayer.
A husband and wife should come together again after a time of prayer, so that Satan will not tempt them.
It is good for the unmarried and widows to remain unmarried, but if they cannot control themselves, let them marry.
The Lord commands that a wife not separate from her husband, or if she does, remain unmarried or go back to her family.
A slave called by the Lord is the Lord's freedman, and a free man called is Caesar's slave.
